tasks.title: UX/UI & Lao Copy System Overhaul
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All visible UI copy in authentic Lao, no unicode emojis, Lucide icons used.

tasks.title: Preflight & Unit Normalization (technical_specs.unit fix)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Distinguish dimension unit (mm) from consumption unit (sheet), imposition OFF handles paper specs cleanly.

tasks.title: PDF Inline Canvas Preview
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fast first page PDF rendering without synchronous full-preflight blocking.

tasks.title: Digital Proof Contract Sync (F8 Response)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: proof_review.go returns committed: true, updated_id, proof_url, proof_version on HTTP 200.

tasks.title: Finance Residual State Sync (F4 Card 3 Counter)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Approving slip immediately updates Card 3 pending count via TanStack query invalidation.

tasks.title: Repricing Item Payload Integrity (F6)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Replacement quote creation succeeds with HTTP 200 without PRICE_SOURCE_ITEMS_MISMATCH.

tasks.title: Artwork Replacement Spec Protection (F7)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Replacing pre-work PDF artwork without changing dimensions does not trip REPRICE_REQUIRED.

tasks.title: Actual Payment Record Durability (F9)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: OrderCompletedSummaryPage renders actual payment slips and verified records, no hardcoded mock text.

tasks.title: Baseline Preservation Audit (F1, F2, F3, F5)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Existing passed tests continue to pass; no regressions in pricing or stock lifecycle.

tasks.title: Freeze Package & Manifest Preparation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Build passes cleanly, manifest file generated with file hashes.

tasks.title: Independent Antigravity Verification
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Internal verification matrix yields 100% PASS ready for Codex QA recheck.

tasks.title: Automatic Paper Consumption & Decoupled Dimensions (Gap 1)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A4 on A3 stock supports 2 cuts in OFF mode; stock/job mismatch does not block save; manual overrides preserved.

tasks.title: Zero Coverage Preservation (Gap 2)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Legitimate 0% CMYK channel coverage is strictly preserved and never overwritten by average or fallback.

tasks.title: Printed-Area Ink Calculation (Gap 3)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Ink is calculated on actual finished job area and impressions, decoupled from parent sheet margins/waste.

tasks.title: Reproducible Counter Cash & Explicit Bank Selection (Gap 4)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Cash method in canonical migrations; foreign keys preserved; bank transfer uses explicitly selected receiving account without silent bcel_one default.
